name: Vofspace
headline: A virtual office that has hosted 20K+ sessions and processed $3M+
overview: Vofspace is a virtual office platform built end to end by Techlio for independent professionals, coaches, educators and service providers. It brings HD video meetings, scheduling, payment collection and per-client communication into one dashboard.

challenges.title: Fragmented professional tools
challenges.text: Independent professionals ran video, scheduling, invoicing and messaging across four to six platforms.

challenges.title: No automated payment collection
challenges.text: Billing after sessions was manual and prone to delays.

challenges.title: No dedicated client communication
challenges.text: Conversations happened in email or WhatsApp with no per-client history.

challenges.title: Barriers for non-technical users
challenges.text: Counsellors, instructors and tutors needed zero technical setup and no downloads for their clients.

solutions.title: Unified virtual office dashboard
solutions.text: HD video, scheduling, payments and client communication in one environment.

solutions.title: Automated post-session billing
solutions.text: Stripe-powered collection that triggers after each session, removing manual invoicing.

solutions.title: Per-client channels
solutions.text: A dedicated messaging channel for each client, keeping history and notes in one view.

solutions.title: Zero-download client access
solutions.text: A browser-native experience where clients join from a link on any device.

results: 20K+ sessions hosted and $3M+ processed through automated billing
Professionals across 15+ industries on the platform
Post-session payment delays reduced to near zero
